text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Task Response - Band 9: Fully addresses all parts of the task. Presents a fully developed position with ideas that are extended and well supported.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Task Response - Band 8: Sufficiently addresses all parts of the task. Presents a well-developed response with relevant, extended and supported ideas.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Task Response - Band 7: Addresses all parts of the task. Presents a clear position throughout. Ideas are extended and supported, though may be over-generalised or lack focus in places.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Task Response - Band 6: Addresses all parts of the task, though some parts more fully than others. Presents a relevant position, but conclusions may be unclear or repetitive. Some ideas are relevant but underdeveloped or unclear.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Task Response - Band 5: Addresses the task only partially; the format may be inappropriate in places. Expresses a position but development is not always clear and a conclusion may be missing. Some ideas are limited, not well supported, or repetitive.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Task Response - Band 4: Responds to the task only minimally or tangentially; the format may be inappropriate. Position is unclear. Main ideas are difficult to identify, may be irrelevant or repetitive, and are weakly supported.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Task Response - Band 3: Does not adequately address any part of the task. Does not express a clear position. Presents few ideas, which are largely undeveloped or irrelevant.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Task Response - Band 2: Barely responds to the task. Does not express a position. May attempt to present one or two ideas but there is no development.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Task Response - Band 1: Answer is completely unrelated to the task; no message is communicated.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Coherence and Cohesion - Band 9: Uses cohesion in such a way that it attracts no attention. Skilfully manages paragraphing.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Coherence and Cohesion - Band 8: Sequences information and ideas logically. Manages all aspects of cohesion well. Uses paragraphing sufficiently and appropriately.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Coherence and Cohesion - Band 7: Logically organises information and ideas with clear progression throughout. Uses a range of cohesive devices appropriately, although there may be some under- or over-use. Presents a clear central topic within each paragraph.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Coherence and Cohesion - Band 6: Arranges information and ideas coherently with clear overall progression. Uses cohesive devices effectively, but cohesion within and between sentences may be faulty or mechanical. May not always use referencing clearly or appropriately. Uses paragraphing, but not always logically.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Coherence and Cohesion - Band 5: Presents information with some organisation but there may be a lack of overall progression. Makes inadequate, inaccurate or over-use of cohesive devices. May be repetitive because of lack of referencing and substitution. May not write in paragraphs, or paragraphing may be inadequate.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Coherence and Cohesion - Band 4: Presents information and ideas but these are not arranged coherently and there is no clear progression. Uses some basic cohesive devices but these may be inaccurate or repetitive. May not write in paragraphs, or their use may be confusing.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Coherence and Cohesion - Band 3: Does not organise ideas logically. May use a very limited range of cohesive devices, and those used may not indicate a logical relationship between ideas.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Coherence and Cohesion - Band 2: Has very little control of organisational features.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Coherence and Cohesion - Band 1: Fails to communicate any message (no separate descriptor for this criterion).
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Lexical Resource - Band 9: Uses a wide range of vocabulary with very natural and sophisticated control of lexical features; rare minor errors occur only as slips.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Lexical Resource - Band 8: Uses a wide range of vocabulary fluently and flexibly to convey precise meanings. Skilfully uses uncommon lexical items but there may be occasional inaccuracies in word choice and collocation. Produces rare errors in spelling and/or word formation.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Lexical Resource - Band 7: Uses a sufficient range of vocabulary to allow some flexibility and precision. Uses less common lexical items with some awareness of style and collocation. May produce occasional errors in word choice, spelling and/or word formation.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Lexical Resource - Band 6: Uses an adequate range of vocabulary for the task. Attempts to use less common vocabulary but with some inaccuracy. Makes some errors in spelling and/or word formation, but they do not impede communication.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Lexical Resource - Band 5: Uses a limited range of vocabulary, but this is minimally adequate for the task. May make noticeable errors in spelling and/or word formation that may cause some difficulty for the reader.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Lexical Resource - Band 4: Uses only basic vocabulary which may be used repetitively or which may be inappropriate for the task. Has limited control of word formation and/or spelling; errors may cause strain for the reader.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Lexical Resource - Band 3: Uses only a very limited range of words and expressions with very limited control of word formation and/or spelling. Errors may severely distort the message.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Lexical Resource - Band 2: Uses an extremely limited range of vocabulary; essentially no control of word formation and/or spelling.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Lexical Resource - Band 1: Can only use a few isolated words.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Grammatical Range and Accuracy - Band 9: Uses a wide range of structures with full flexibility and accuracy; rare minor errors occur only as slips.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Grammatical Range and Accuracy - Band 8: Uses a wide range of structures. The majority of sentences are error-free. Makes only very occasional errors or inappropriacies.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Grammatical Range and Accuracy - Band 7: Uses a variety of complex structures. Produces frequent error-free sentences. Has good control of grammar and punctuation but may make a few errors.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Grammatical Range and Accuracy - Band 6: Uses a mix of simple and complex sentence forms. Makes some errors in grammar and punctuation but they rarely reduce communication.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Grammatical Range and Accuracy - Band 5: Uses only a limited range of structures. Attempts complex sentences but these tend to be less accurate than simple sentences. May make frequent grammatical errors and faulty punctuation; errors can cause some difficulty for the reader.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Grammatical Range and Accuracy - Band 4: Uses only a very limited range of structures with only rare use of subordinate clauses. Some structures are accurate but errors predominate, and punctuation is often faulty.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Grammatical Range and Accuracy - Band 3: Attempts sentence forms but errors in grammar and punctuation predominate and distort the meaning.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Grammatical Range and Accuracy - Band 2: Cannot use sentence forms except in memorised phrases.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English

text: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Grammatical Range and Accuracy - Band 1: Cannot use sentence forms at all.
source: IELTS Writing Task 2 Band Descriptors (public version) - British Council / IDP IELTS / Cambridge English
